description: Unified-app tabs only. tool_id must match ra_ai_nav_catalog() and nav_panel titles.

tools.title: Overview
tools.purpose: Summary cards and group-health table (extinct, exploding, odd ResN/StructN).
example_questions: What can Reactive Atlantis do?
Which groups look extinct or exploding?
Why is a group collapsing?
tools.what_to_look_for: Groups below 1% of initial biomass, more than tenfold growth, age classes outside 0.5-1.5 of initial ResN/StructN.
tools.limitations: Flags are ratios, not a process diagnosis.

tools.title: Compare
tools.purpose: Biomass and numbers through time; Bt/B0; age structure.
example_questions: Where do I see biomass trajectories?
Is biomass relative to initial outside 0.5-1.5?
tools.what_to_look_for: Trend versus initial, age-structure change, observed biomass points.
tools.limitations: Does not name the process that caused a trend.

tools.title: Ages
tools.purpose: Whole-system age-class ResN, StructN, Numbers, Biomass.
example_questions: How do I inspect condition by age?
Where is reserve nitrogen by cohort?
tools.limitations: Whole-system only. Spatial by-age is on Spatial.

tools.title: Spatial
tools.purpose: Box map by layer and time; series; by-age; predator-prey overlap.
example_questions: Where is the biomass in space?
Did the stock move into poor boxes?
Where do predator and prey overlap?
tools.what_to_look_for: Per-box water layers, sediment last, unused boxes, time slider. Overlap view: local 2 min(Bp,Bq)/(Bp+Bq) on the map; Schoener D in the series.
tools.limitations: Needs a parseable BGM. Map is empty without polygons. Overlap uses box biomass, not layers.

tools.title: Consumption
tools.purpose: Tonnes consumed from outputPROD.nc with DietCheck.
example_questions: Is intake too low?
Where is consumption?
tools.what_to_look_for: Eat and Grazing series, predator versus prey views.

tools.title: Physics
tools.purpose: Temperature, salinity, nutrients and layer thickness.
example_questions: Where are temperature and nitrate shown?
tools.what_to_look_for: Real water-column layers per box; padded layers excluded.
tools.limitations: A tracer pattern is not a biological diagnosis.

tools.title: Multi-run
tools.purpose: Overlay series from extra run pairs.
example_questions: How do I compare two runs?
tools.what_to_look_for: Biomass, SSB, YOY or catch overlays; ensemble range.
tools.limitations: Needs extra named pairs in the sidebar.

tools.title: Predation
example_questions: Where do I inspect predation?
What is this group eating?
tools.what_to_look_for: Diet shifts, top prey, Other remainder.

tools.title: Food web
example_questions: How do I see the food web?
tools.what_to_look_for: Trophic connections above the diet threshold.
tools.limitations: Weak links are hidden by the threshold.

tools.title: Recruitment
tools.purpose: YOY, SSB, recruits vs spawning stock, Beverton-Holt side panel.
example_questions: What should I check when recruitment is low?
Where do I plot recruits against SSB?
tools.what_to_look_for: YOY.txt CODE.0, SSB, recruits vs SSB scatter, larvae from the curve.
tools.limitations: Recalculate is a curve what-if, not a saved official run. Recruits vs SSB uses loaded YOY and SSB tables.

tools.title: Growth
tools.purpose: Light, nutrient and eddy limitation for primary producers.
example_questions: Are primary producers limited?
tools.what_to_look_for: Limitation by layer for a producer group.
tools.limitations: Not vertebrate weight-at-age. Use Ages for ResN/StructN.

tools.title: Catch
tools.purpose: Catch by group or fleet; skill versus observed.
example_questions: How do I compare catch to observations?
tools.what_to_look_for: Fleet stacks; Skill vs observed when a catch CSV is loaded.
tools.limitations: Skill is view=skill on this tab, not a separate tool_id.

tools.title: Feeding
tools.purpose: Full pPREY matrix, realised DietCheck and consumed biomass for the selected pair, diagnostics, edited-versus-original compare.
example_questions: What is pPREY?
What does KLP represent?
How does realised diet compare to pPREY?
tools.what_to_look_for: pPREY>0 with zero gape overlap; uneaten prey; DietCheck mismatch; DietCheck proportion and consumed tonnes for the clicked predator/prey.
tools.limitations: pPREY is availability, not realised diet. In-session edits are not prm writes. Consumed biomass needs outputPROD.nc.

tools.title: Mortality
tools.purpose: Fishing, natural and predation mortality by age; predation by predator; Mort.txt F vs M.
example_questions: What does mL represent?
Has fishing mortality increased?
Which predators drive predation mortality?
tools.what_to_look_for: Stacked F / M1 / M2 by age; SpecificPredMort by predator; missing-file notes for Mort.txt, SpecificMort.txt, SpecificPredMort.txt.
tools.limitations: mL is linear natural mortality, not fishing. Mort.txt is relative F vs M only.
